title: CAT 2025 Question Paper (Slot 2, PYQ) - QA - Compound Interest
subject: QA

questions.q: A loan of Rs $1000$ is fully repaid by two installments of Rs $530$ and Rs $594$, paid at the end of first and second year, respectively. If the interest is compounded annually, then the rate of interest, in percentage, is
questions.explain:
Let the annual multiplier be $x = (1 + r/100)$.
The present value of installments must equal the principal: $\frac{530}{x} + \frac{594}{x^2} = 1000$.
Testing the options, for $r = 8\%$ ($x = 1.08$):
$\frac{530}{1.08} + \frac{594}{1.08^2} = 490.74 + 509.26 = 1000$.
Thus, the interest rate is $8\%$.
